display.title: See how different interests and bachelor choices can take shape at UCR.
display.intro: Explore selected comparisons between Dutch bachelor programmes and study programmes that can be composed at University College Roosevelt. These examples show both close matches and broader ways of combining related subjects.
display.examplesIntro: Explore five selected comparisons. Each shows a different combination of interests and the possibilities and limits of studying them at UCR.

audiences.title: For prospective students
audiences.description: A personalized experience will use the interests you submit to prepare a possible UCR programme and show how it compares with other study options.

audiences.title: For school counselors
audiences.description: A searchable comparison tool will let you find bachelor programmes by name or by a student's interests and open a pre-produced UCR comparison.

examples.title: Economics and Business Economics at Utrecht University
examples.description: A selected comparison around economics, politics, institutions and development.

examples.title: Astronomy at the University of Groningen
examples.description: See how mathematics, computing and Earth systems can connect with an interest in astronomy, and which specialist subjects UCR does not offer.

examples.title: Global Communication Science at the University of Amsterdam
examples.description: A comparison connecting communication, language, marketing and behavioural perspectives.

examples.title: Criminologie at Erasmus University Rotterdam
examples.description: A comparison showing how UCR approaches crime and justice through related fields rather than a full criminology curriculum.

examples.title: Wiskunde en Toepassingen at Utrecht University
examples.description: A comparison centred on mathematics, quantitative methods and climate-related applications.
